allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
[opendps] Fix TCP bridge crash by deferring setup until network ready

- Move tcp_bridge_enabled_ and tcp_bridge_port_ outside #ifdef block
  so Python codegen works regardless of socket support
- Add tcp_bridge_initialized_ flag to track setup state
- Defer TCP bridge socket setup to loop\(\) instead of setup\(\)
- Check network::is_connected\(\) before initializing sockets
- This prevents crashes when ESP32 boots before network is ready

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
